name: golem
description: an Iron Golem (Fall from Heaven), a massive hulking construct of dark riveted steel plates with rust streaks, bound by riveted bronze-gold bands: a round domed iron head with a bronze crest and a glowing orange visor slit for eyes, huge rounded shoulder plates, a bronze belt with a round gold buckle, thick armoured legs on big iron feet, and two huge clenched iron fists; it carries no weapon and strikes with its LEFT fist
hands: no weapon: its left fist on the screen-right side is the striking fist, and its right fist on the screen-left side stays an empty clenched iron fist

strike.1: anticipation: weight shifts back onto the rear leg, the massive torso leans back, the left arm is lifted up over the domed head with the huge iron fist high
strike.2: wind-up extreme: body coiled back and slightly crouched, the left iron fist cocked behind the domed head, the right fist tucked in
strike.3: swing: the front foot steps toward the lower-right, the torso whips forward, the left arm sweeps up and over toward the lower-right with the huge iron fist high, about to come down
strike.4: contact: the left arm fully extended toward the lower-right, the huge iron fist smashing down-right, front knee bent, body low and leaning in, the right fist swung back for balance
strike.5: follow-through: the iron fist carries on down until it nearly touches the ground at the lower-right, the massive torso twisted, the shoulder plates rolling forward
strike.6: recover: body rises, front foot pulls back halfway, the left iron fist comes back up to hang at its side

flinch.0: impact: hit from the lower-right; the domed iron head snaps back toward the upper-left, the orange visor glow flickering, the heavy torso jolts back, both arms jerk outward (the right fist flung out to the left, the left fist thrown up and out)
flinch.1: recoil extreme: leaning back further, knees bent, the left iron fist dipping, the right arm still out

death.1: stagger back: a step back with the near foot, the massive body thrown back, the left iron fist flung up, the right arm drooping
death.2: knees buckle: hips drop, knees fold forward, the torso slumps forward, the domed head droops, the visor glow dimming, the left fist lowering
death.3: kneeling: on both knees, slumped forward, the left iron fist resting on the ground, the right arm hanging
death.4: falling back: the torso tips back toward the upper-left, both iron arms going limp, legs slide forward
death.5: hits the ground: lying on its back along the ground, feet toward the lower-right and head toward the upper-left; the heavy iron arms flung out at its sides, nothing in its fists
death.6: bounce: the domed head and the shoulders lift slightly off the ground, the heavy plates rock
death.7: corpse: lying flat and still on its back, the visor slit dark and cold, the iron fists open on the ground beside it
